ns2:course.label: Special Problems
ns2:course.description: (IB 290) Laboratory and/or field research and/or reading supervised by faculty members in the School of Integrative Biology. May be repeated. Approved for S/U grading only. No more than a combined maximum of 10 hours of IB 290 or IB 292 may count toward graduation for IB majors. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
